title: 第2章 身材不错
slug: 班级地铁求生全班就我一个男生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“青青姐，你太厉害了！”

陆小小兴奋地跳了起来。

“快帮我们做衣服吧！”

她动作幅度太大，一时间波澜壮阔。

秦守看了一眼，被深深震撼到了。

陆小小身材娇小，尺寸却是大的惊人，真是天赋异禀。

苏青青脸上笑容褪去，神情有些为难。

“那个……”她的声音比刚才小了很多，“我暂时还做不了衣服。”

陆小小很失望。

“啊，为什么？”

苏青青解释道。

“制作衣服需要布料。”

陆小小问道。

“布料是什么，怎么获得？”

苏青青回答道。

“我的裁缝能力有分解技能，可以把普通衣服分解成布料。”

普通衣服！

众女的目光，全部汇聚到秦守身上。

整个地铁车厢，只有秦守一个人穿了衣服。

“秦守。”陆小小的声音忽然变得很甜，甜得秦守后背一紧，“你一个人穿这么多，不热吗？”

“……不热。”

“我觉得你热，快把衣服脱了吧！”

陆小小摩拳擦掌，甚至都想上来抢衣服了。

姜瑶深吸了一口气。

“秦守，我们真的需要你的衣服！”

秦守眼中闪过一抹犹豫。

让女生们穿上衣服，意味着他再也看不到这么靓丽的风景线了。

多少有点遗憾！

但很快，秦守就打消了这种念头。

作为一个脱离了低级趣味的好人，他决定助人为乐。

“我可以把衣服贡献给大家！”

秦守脱下了自己的T恤。

苏青青挥动手中剪刀。

咔嚓咔嚓！

银光闪耀，衣服迅速被分解成布料。

【T恤分解成功，获得布料×4】

一共获得了4块布料。

众女生们翘首以盼，等待苏青青制造衣服。

苏青青却是摇了摇头。

“不够！就算是最省布料的衣服款式，一块布料也只能做一套衣服，我们有九个人，至少需要9块布料！”

众女的目光再次看向秦守。

车厢里安静了一瞬。

然后八双眼睛齐刷刷地转向了秦守。

准确地说，转向了他身上的牛仔裤。

Page (1/3)

"Sister Qingqing, you are so amazing!"

Lu Xiaoxiao jumped up excitedly.

"Hurry and help us make clothes!"

The range of her movements was too large, and her movements were magnificent for a moment.

Qin Shou took one look and was deeply shocked.

Lu Xiaoxiao is petite, but her size is astonishing. She is really talented.

The smile on Su Qingqing's face faded, and she looked a little embarrassed.

"Well..." Her voice was much softer than before, "I can't make clothes yet."

Lu Xiaoxiao was disappointed.

"Ah, why?"

Su Qingqing explained.

“You need fabric to make clothes.”

Lu Xiaoxiao asked.

"What is cloth and how to get it?"

Su Qingqing replied.

"My tailoring ability has the decomposition skill, which can decompose ordinary clothes into fabrics."

Ordinary clothes!

All the girls' eyes were focused on Qin Shou.

In the entire subway car, Qin Shou was the only one wearing clothes.

"Qin Shou." Lu Xiaoxiao's voice suddenly became very sweet, so sweet that Qin Shou's back tightened, "Isn't it hot for you to wear so much alone?"

"...not hot."

"I think you're hot, take off your clothes quickly!"

Lu Xiaoxiao was so excited that he even wanted to come up and grab his clothes.

Jiang Yao took a deep breath.

"Qin Shou, we really need your clothes!"

A flash of hesitation flashed in Qin Shou's eyes.

Letting the girls put on clothes meant that he would never see such a beautiful scenery again.

What a pity!

But soon, Qin Shou gave up this idea.

As a good person who has escaped from vulgar taste, he decided to help others.

"I can donate my clothes to everyone!"

Qin Shou took off his T-shirt.

Su Qingqing waved the scissors in her hand.

Click, click, click!

The silver light shone and the clothes were quickly broken down into cloth.

[T-shirt decomposed successfully, obtained cloth × 4]

A total of 4 pieces of fabric were obtained.

The girls are eagerly waiting for Su Qingqing to make clothes.

Su Qingqing shook her head.

"Not enough! Even for the most fabric-saving clothing styles, one piece of fabric can only make one set of clothes. There are nine of us, and we need at least 9 pieces of fabric!"

The girls looked at Qin Shou again.

The car was quiet for a moment.

Then eight pairs of eyes turned to Qin Shou.

Or rather, turning to the jeans he was wearing.
